adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, a new unconditional fetch to the Salesforce token endpoint is added at lines 75-87 during the getClient() method. This fetch runs every time a client is constructed, and if it fails (line 83: 'if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError'), the entire client construction fails. This is a valid architectural concern - the code now requires a successful token refresh on every client instantiation, which could cause availability issues if the token endpoint is temporarily unavailable, even when the existing access token might still be valid. However, this is a design/architecture concern rather than a definite bug, as eager refresh could be intentional for ensuring fresh tokens.
